subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should install-time hook metadata be limited to a 1 MiB regular `HOOK.md` file?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish technical correctness, but the fixed threshold and stricter accepted-file shape are compatibility policy that require hook-owner intent.

options.title: Accept the bounded contract
options.body: Treat oversized or linked `HOOK.md` metadata as invalid hook package input and merge after the normal exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Revise the package contract
options.body: Choose a different threshold or preserve linked metadata behavior, then add matching focused tests and runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Treat oversized or linked `HOOK.md` metadata as invalid hook package input and merge after the normal exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the affected installation path and is the current live assignee.
